convert_hubert_checkpoint: convert a fairseq Hubert checkpoint to a HuggingFace PyTorch model format
recursively_load_weights: recursively load fairseq model weights into a HuggingFace Hubert model
load_conv_layer: load convolutional layer weights from a fairseq checkpoint into the feature extractor
set_recursively: set recursively traversed HuggingFace model attributes with fairseq weight values
convert_hubert_cli: run the CLI to convert a fairseq Hubert checkpoint to HuggingFace transformers format
